# Rappler

> Rappler is the Philippines' leading digital news platform covering breaking news, investigative journalism, and in-depth analysis on politics, business, technology, and global affairs.

Rappler combines traditional journalism with digital-first reporting, featuring video content, fact-checking services, and premium membership offerings. The platform covers Philippine politics extensively while maintaining international news coverage and specialized sections on technology, business, environment, and science.

## Key Topics

- Philippine politics
- Duterte-ICC
- Investigative journalism
- Fact-checking
- Artificial intelligence
- Philippine economy
- Corruption
- Breaking news
- Technology
- Climate change
- International relations
- Newsbreak
- Misinformation
- Marcos administration
- Public accountability

## Breaking News & Politics

- [Philippines | Latest news and top stories](https://www.rappler.com/nation): Breaking Philippine news on politics, Marcos administration, Duterte-ICC coverage
- [Investigative](https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/investigative): Investigative journalism exposing corruption, Pharmally scandal, government accountability
- [Inside Track](https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/inside-track): Intelligence column on Philippine politics, officials, corporate controversies, events
- [Rappler Special Coverages](https://www.rappler.com/topic/special-coverages): Special event coverage: Duterte-ICC, EDSA Revolution, SEA Games, political events

## News & Verification

- [Fact Check](https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-check): Fact-checking service combating misinformation, IFCN signatory, disinformation debunking
- [Video](https://www.rappler.com/video): Video hub for news, talk shows, documentaries on politics, tech, business, sports
- [World](https://www.rappler.com/world): Global news from Africa, Asia, Europe covering geopolitics, international relations

## Business & Technology

- [Technology](https://www.rappler.com/technology): Tech news on AI chips, cybersecurity, semiconductors, artificial intelligence
- [Business](https://www.rappler.com/business): Business news on Philippine economy, markets, toll discounts, peso-dollar rates
- [Environment](https://www.rappler.com/environment): Environmental coverage on renewable energy, climate change, sustainability in Philippines

## Lifestyle & Culture

- [People - RAPPLER](https://www.rappler.com/people): Celebrity, athlete, entertainment news hub featuring Chuck Norris, Alex Eala, obituaries
- [Science](https://www.rappler.com/science): Science news featuring Filipino scientists, paleontology, research discoveries globally
- [Philippine weather | News and PAGASA forecasts](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/weather): PAGASA weather forecasts, typhoon updates, tropical cyclone tracking for Philippines

## Opinion & Analysis

- [Voices](https://www.rappler.com/voices): Opinion editorials from experts on economy, AI, Philippine politics, social issues

## Membership & Subscriptions

- [Rappler+ Exclusives](https://www.rappler.com/plus-membership-program): Premium membership program offering exclusive content, live chats, expert analysis
- [Subscribe to Rappler email newsletters](https://www.rappler.com/newsletters): Email newsletter subscription hub with curated content, news alerts, exclusive updates

## Optional

- [BrandRap - RAPPLER](https://www.rappler.com/brandrap): Sponsored content platform for brand stories, product reviews, tech partnerships
